title: Who changed it
caption: A figure looked wrong, and Sunil wanted to know who changed it and when. The founder tells his story.
linkedin_text: In ScoreMyBiz the owner can see a list, newest first, of every add, change, removal and mark-paid in his book, in plain words, with who did it: owner, helper or CA. It shows the latest 200 changes and only the owner can open it.
